description.value: Catching Stars Gallery is a BC Artist Cooperative on Bowen Island showcasing handcrafted works by over 50 Canadian artists, including jewellery, pottery, paintings, fine art photography, and wood, stone, and glass creations. Situated just 300 metres from the Bowen Island ferry dock — a 20-minute crossing from Horseshoe Bay — it is one of the first stops cyclists will encounter after rolling off the ferry. The gallery celebrates the island's natural beauty through the work of local and regional artists, and also operates an online shop with worldwide shipping.
